about_the_game:
UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, loot and SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

Key Features

Magical tools: Every character arrives with a magical tool of their own quirky, powerful, and a little unpredictable. It’s the heart of their playstyle and personality!

Explore an ever-changing bunker: Twisted by dark magic, the bunker shifts with every new run. Beginning with a familiar office and home environment, you will descend into wilder areas like the underground garden and eventually reach the dark magic nexus.

Face your fears: Battle the mischievous fearmongers, enemies born from your own dark side, and bosses that grow more dangerous the deeper you go.

Improvised gameplay collides with co-op chaos: Break and fix bunker systems like power and lighting, use elemental magic to electrify water or burn wooden obstacles, and use your items and tools to overcome unpredictable hazards and defeat the enemies which lurk in the shadows.

SMUSH everything: Combine everyday junk and bizarre food items including, cell phone batteries, hairspray cans, and frogspawn sandwiches into wild elemental weapons and potions. Experiment to adapt and survive.

Spooky-cozy: Take a break between runs in the Den, the cozy basement at the top of the bunker. Upgrade your character, and learn more about the spooky history of the manor that you're trapped beneath, and those who once lived there… and those who might still be there…

Co-op craziness: Play solo or with up to 4 players online co-op. Proximity voice chat keeps things immersive... or hilariously loud.

Fearful consequences: Spooky events will raise your fear gauge - keep it under control or run the risk of triggering strange hallucinations, or even worse - spawning the creatures you thought you had forgotten.

Cat quests: Meet McClane, a thousand year old spirit cat who was there at the start of all this mess. Perform unusual tasks for this cantankerous cat, and he’ll help you uncover the deepest secrets of the bunker.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
